## bh-p09 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Consciousness dances and sings; obtaining the Lord is defined as rare vision — fenced to the initiated.

*Rasa: ānanda (bliss) with adbhuta (wonder) — The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of rejoicing (hṛṣṭi); the vyabhicāri is joy (camatkāra) of obtaining the vision. The rasa is bliss as spontaneous joy, then defined as vision — not emotion but recognition.*
